# SPD-054 — Bash hook: a trap string runs a command the hook never reads (Law 7)

## Brief
trap stores shell code the shell runs later (EXIT, DEBUG before every command, ERR, signals), and analyse_words dispatches trap as kind other, so a member's git write inside a trap string is silent.

Evidence: Probed from the SPD-043 scratchpad with a fake git first on PATH (zsh 5.9 -f, zsh -f -o nobareglobqual, bash 3.2, sh): trap 'git push' EXIT ran git push in all four; the hook on main reads kind other with no finding. SPD-043 only treats trap as leaving every variable uncertain. The harness itself refuses shell text naming trap in a worktree session, which is no cover for the hook in other sessions.

## Size, persona and model decision
One engineer on opus, no children: one hook fix in bin/spud_ledger.py (a trap branch in analyse_words beside eval and a shell's -c string, and trap in GLOB_COMMAND_SAMPLES) with red-first tests in tests/test_hooks.py, the same shape as SPD-043 and SPD-046, built in worktree spd-054-trap-string. Design settled by Spud at start: the action string is read as shell text the way eval's words and a shell's -c string are, with its own quotes, at a working directory the hook treats as unknown since the string runs later; a string the hook cannot resolve is refused for a member; the list, print and reset forms stay silent; Spud is unchanged.

## Outcome
A member's trap action string is now read by the Bash hook as the shell text it is, with its own quotes, in both the bash position (after options and --) and the zsh position (the word after trap), at a directory the hook treats as unknown since the action runs later: a VCS write inside it is refused under Law 7, a spud write under Law 6 or the actor check, a relative redirection or tee inside it with the existing cannot-follow reason, and an action word holding an unresolvable expansion as SPD-043 refuses one. trap alone, -p, -l, -, - EXIT, '' EXIT and the single-argument form stay silent or fail closed as probed in bash 3.2, zsh 5.9 -f, zsh -f -o nobareglobqual and sh; env, nohup and exec before trap stay other; the command word reached through builtin, command, time, noglob, a glob or a resolved variable, and inside eval, sh -c, a function, a subshell, a pipeline or a loop, is read the same. Round 2, from Spud's probe: coproc { trap 'git push' EXIT; } runs in zsh's forked shell, so coproc now sets a fork effect under which a builtin runs but no directory comes back, and cd and source keep their readings. Spud unchanged. TrapActionTest 11 methods, red first. Differential over 6,334 strings: 399 changed, all silent to deny, none refused to silent. Suite 677: OK on three of Spud's four reruns, the fourth had one failure the tail did not name and it never recurred. Merged into main as 2bb5b31; worktree spd-054-trap-string and its branch deleted. Found along the way: SPD-059 (P2, an alias run through eval, from proposal 63) and SPD-060 (P3, a named coproc hides its group, pre-existing on main).
